The problem

The problem starts after the site walk.

You leave with hundreds of photos, scattered notes and half the job still in your head. By the time the quote gets written, details get missed.

Without ScopeSnap
  • Photos buried in your camera roll
  • Notes spread across messages and voice memos
  • Scope written from memory
  • Missed items found mid-build
  • Messy handover to clients or trades
With ScopeSnap
  • Photos, notes and voice captured in one place
  • Everything grouped by room as you walk
  • AI cleans up your notes on the spot
  • Clear scope record before you leave site
  • Cleaner quoting and easier handover
Features

Built for site walks, not office admin.

Organised by room

Every photo, note and voice recording stays attached to the room it belongs to. Nothing to sort later.

Capture as you walk

Take photos room by room while you walk the job. No typing. No sorting after the fact.

Talk it through. ScopeSnap writes it up.

Speak naturally as you walk. ScopeSnap strips the filler and turns it into clean scope notes.

Clear scope reports

Generate a structured scope before you leave site. Quote from it, send it to the client, or hand it to your team.

How it works

Four steps. Scope done.

1

Open the job

Choose the room or area you’re standing in. Add rooms as you go.

2

Capture as you walk

Take photos, add notes or talk through what you see. Everything tags to the current room.

3

ScopeSnap organises it

Grouped by room. Voice notes cleaned up. Scope items ready to review.

4

Export a clear scope

Quote from it, send it to the client, or hand it to your team — before you leave site.

Missed items cost money.

Every item missed on site ends up as a variation, a dispute, or money out of your pocket. ScopeSnap keeps the record straight from the first walkthrough.

Why we built this

Built by a builder, for builders.

ScopeSnap came from a simple problem: site walks create too much loose information. Photos in the camera roll. Voice notes forgotten. Scope items written from memory days later.

So we built a faster way to capture the job while you’re standing in it. Built in the field, not a boardroom.
